field.rationale: WebSearch工具在10+次查询中均返回空结果（中文：闲鱼RTX3090/4090/价格/成交/2025/2026，英文：RTX3090/4090/A100 used price second hand）。WebFetch也对ebay/amazon/techpowerup返回503/403/timeout。无法获取实时列表数据。基于训练数据市场知识估算（非可验证证据）：RTX 3090 24GB 中国二手约 ¥3,000-4,000 RMB (~$420-560 USD)，受2022年后加密货币挖矿崩盘影响大量二手涌入；RTX 4090 24GB 中国二手约 ¥6,000-9,000 RMB (~$840-1,260 USD）。此数据为领域知识而非实测证据，置信度降级为0.6，标记为research_required。建议下一阶段通过浏览器（ego-browser）直接访问闲鱼/淘宝/硬件通获取精确报价。

RTX_3090_24GB.market_notes: Crypto mining crash after 2022 flooded market with used 3090s. Price dropped from ¥5500+ (2022 peak) to current levels. Most used units are mining/heavy compute loads.

RTX_4090_24GB.market_notes: Lower mining impact. Price decline driven by RTX 5090 launch anticipation.
